Executive Summary Recent national studies indicate inter-regional transmission expansion can provide low-cost options to maintain grid reliability while meeting growing demand (IEA, 2025; Rohrer, 2024; U.S. Department of Energy, 2022; U.S. Department of Energy, 2024; Wood Mackenzie, 2024). However, constraints in domestic supply chains may limit grid expansion across the United States, with higher costs and longer delays for required transmission equipment.
